title: Remove Launch settings policy flat exports
summary: Removed six transitional Settings policy/patch flat window aliases and moved Launch policy-impact dependency wiring to window.mediaPipelineSettingsView. WebView flat exports are now 385 across 48 files.
reason: Continue the active WebView flat export cleanup workstream by reducing touched-domain compatibility globals while preserving namespace-first access and browser/static evidence.
behavior_before: Launch consumed Settings policy-impact and patch-state helpers through window.settingsPolicyDeltaRows, window.settingsPolicyDeltaStatus, window.settingsLaunchImpactRows, window.settingsLaunchImpactStatus, window.settingsPatchIsTouched, and window.settingsPatchEffectiveChangedEntries. Settings also published those helpers as transitional flat aliases.
behavior_after: Launch injects the same helpers from window.mediaPipelineSettingsView, and Settings keeps the helpers available through that namespace without the six flat aliases. No backend routes, settings persistence, filesystem mutation, publish/drain, or media policy behavior changed.
manual_validation: Baseline targeted tests failed before the source edit because launchView.js still used the six window.settings* helpers and settingsView.js still assigned the six flat aliases.

rg "window\.(settingsPolicyDeltaRows|settingsPolicyDeltaStatus|settingsLaunchImpactRows|settingsLaunchImpactStatus|settingsPatchIsTouched|settingsPatchEffectiveChangedEntries)\b|Flat export total: 391|Flat exports \(13\)|direct compatibility flat exports remain at 391" Apps Docs apps docs tests -n returned no matches.
npm run webview:contract passed and refreshed docs/generated/WEBVIEW_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_BASELINE.json.
npm run webview:map passed and refreshed docs/generated/WEBVIEW_GODFILE_SPLIT_MAP.md.
npm run webview:slices passed and refreshed docs/generated/WEBVIEW_SPLIT_CANDIDATES.json.
npm run webview:commands passed and refreshed docs/generated/WEBVIEW_COMMAND_BOUNDARY_AUDIT.json after prework flagged it stale.
rollback_plan: Revert this change packet to restore the six Settings policy/patch flat aliases and Launch flat-global lookups, regenerate WebView contract/map/slice/command-boundary artifacts and summaries, and restore WebView flat-export counts in Docs/CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE.md and Docs/inventories/WEBVIEW_GLOBAL_EXPORT_INVENTORY.md.
